question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

In queer street
solution:
The correct meaning is **In debt**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "**In queer street**" is "In debt."
 
• **In queer street: **in trouble, usually because of debt.
 
 
• Example: *He will be in the queer street if he continues buying expensive things.* 
 
 

Therefore, the correct option is "**In debt**." 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Let's look at the meaning and examples of some idioms of the word **"street":**

 
 

 **Idioms**
 **Meaning**
 **Example**
 
 

 **Be a two-way street**
 to be a circumstance where both parties must exert equal effort to attain the intended outcome.
 *Efforts are a two-way street- you have to give them if you want to receive them. *
 
 

 **Back street**
 a location or region that is viewed as unimportant or inconsequential.
 *You will not get profit in your business if you will open your shop in the back street. *
